it does not establish presidential bribery.","Some earlier continuation items overlap later recovered items or bundle materially distinct claims and require deterministic splitting, deduplication, and count reconciliation.","Local V-Dem and WGI observations fit 2000 but remain contextual country-year measures rather than direct evidence of ruler conduct.","The raw V-Dem regime code remains uninterpretable without its codebook.","The dossier has not demonstrated credible saturation because several named, recoverable themes remain materially under-covered." ]}],"global_findings":["The notebook contains no researcher-written score, score range, ranking recommendation, or scoring advice.","Missing evidence is not negative evidence about de la Rúa.","Stable evidence IDs and cross-lens reuse are generally handled correctly, subject to deterministic cleanup of bundled or overlapping items.","The dossier now exceeds minimum evidence and source-family thresholds numerically, but the main remaining weakness is attribution and breadth, not raw count.","Continuation remains warranted because research can still recover attribution, contrary evidence, and missing event themes;
